verified.name: AlternativeTo
verified.how_to_submit: Sign up, click User icon > Suggest new application. Fill in Name, URL, Platforms (Web), License (Free), Description, Tags. Submit for review. Also add as 'alternative to' competitor tools (e.g., Pixlr, Photopea, MyKitchenCalculator).
verified.notes: One of the most respected software directories. Crowdsourced recommendations. Very high DR. Must-submit for all 3 domains.

verified.name: SaaSHub
verified.how_to_submit: Visit https://www.saashub.com/services/submit. Enter product URL, fill in details (name, description, category). Free listing is searchable and comparable. Moderated — not every product listed instantly. Also has SaaSHub Submit tool for multi-directory submission.
verified.notes: Active weekly newsletters through April 2026. DR 78 dofollow backlinks. Free basic listing. Moderated quality control.

verified.name: Product Hunt
verified.how_to_submit: Log in, click Submit > New Product. Enter URL, add tagline (max 60 chars), description, gallery images (2+), select Free pricing. Can schedule up to 1 month ahead. Best launch days: Tuesday-Thursday. Submit at 12:01 AM PST for max visibility. Engagement signals (comments, replies) matter more than raw upvotes in 2026.
verified.notes: Launching is completely free. DR 91 — highest value backlink of any directory. Recommend 4-6 weeks prep before launch. Launch each domain separately on different days.

verified.name: MicroLaunch
verified.how_to_submit: Submit for free and get assigned a random launch date. Product Hunt-style daily launches with community voting. $30 premium option to pick your launch date and get extra visibility. Has 'Add Your Deal' and 'Feature Your App' options.
verified.notes: Confirmed still active in 2026 with recent product submissions. Free tier available. DR 59 dofollow backlinks.

verified.name: Uneed
verified.how_to_submit: Visit https://www.uneed.best/submit-a-tool. Create account, fill in product details. Free submission enters daily feed where every product gets a chance. Account required to submit and modify later. Platform had 355K visits and 1M+ page views in 2026. $30+ for express listing.
verified.notes: Confirmed active with 355K+ visits in 2026. Fair algorithm — every submission gets daily feed exposure. Dedicated submit-a-tool page confirmed.

new_finds.name: BetaList
new_finds.how_to_submit: Visit betalist.com/submit. Submit product for free — gets placed in queue (approx 2 month wait). $99 to skip queue and pick launch date. Need working product with decent landing page. Templates and pages with little product info are rejected.
new_finds.notes: Original beta-stage directory. Free tier has long wait but DR 75 dofollow backlinks are valuable. Submission guidelines at betalist.com/criteria.

new_finds.name: Capterra
new_finds.how_to_submit: Sign up as a vendor at capterra.com/vendors/sign-up. Create free product listing with description, screenshots, pricing info. Free basic listing is searchable. Paid options for premium placement.
new_finds.notes: DR 91 — extremely high authority. Free basic listing. One of the most trusted software review sites. Excellent for pictureeditor.net especially.

new_finds.name: SourceForge
new_finds.how_to_submit: Create project at sourceforge.net/create/. Free listing for software tools. Add description, screenshots, category. DR 92 with dofollow backlinks.
new_finds.notes: DR 92 — highest authority directory available. Free project creation. Long-established software directory.

new_finds.name: Toolify.ai
new_finds.how_to_submit: Visit toolify.ai/submit. Free submission for basic listing. 26K+ tools across 459 categories. Updated daily. $99 paid promotion option for boosted visibility.
new_finds.notes: Free basic submission. Best suited for pictureeditor.net if it has any AI features. Large directory with millions of monthly visitors.

new_finds.name: DevHunt

new_finds.notes: Good fit for developer-oriented positioning of the tools. Free submission.
